description: Design reference from the Signal Flow prototype (Claude Design export, inline styles). The React version is not built yet, so rebuild this structure with the listed Carbon components and --at-* tokens; do not copy the prototype markup, which fails validate_page. Priorities: a 3 x 3 importance by effort grid with zones (Quick wins, Major projects, Fill-ins, Reconsider). Themes are dragged between cells; the detail side shows the suggested and edited values and a Reset. Provide Select controls for importance and effort in the side panel so the matrix is usable without dragging. Edits are PATCH /themes/:id (stored as overrides); Reset and Reset all delete the overrides.
